# developerhub_registered_users (Data Source)

Registered Developer Hub developers ("GET /api/1.0/registrations?type=registered" - see DESIGN.md §5/§7). Use this to look up a user_id (== developer_id) for developerhub_application.developer_id rather than copying it from the Developer Hub UI by hand.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "developerhub_registered_users" "all" {}

output "developer_ids" {
  value = [for u in data.developerhub_registered_users.all.user : u.user_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier ("registered_users") for Terraform Plugin Framework data source convention.
- `user` (Attributes List) The registered developers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

- `role` (Attributes List) The developer's role assignments and their status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user--role))
- `user_id` (String) The developer id, usable as developerhub_application.developer_id.
